title: platform-standup-2026-03-21
content:
Platform Engineering Standup - 2026-03-21
Attendees: Ava Chen (owner), Miguel Torres, Priya Nair, Jordan Blake, Sofia Martinez, Ken Liu (SRE sync)
Chairs: Ava

Highlights / Context
- Focus this week: control plane stability for new routing policy rollout, quota enforcement edge cases, and auth token renewal bugs seen in Dedicated customers.
- Traffic: saw a small spike on 2026-03-20 (approx +18% peak RPS) after A/B experiment; no service-level outage but increased 5xx rate in control-plane write path.

Yesterday / Updates
- Control plane (Miguel): Investigated increased 5xxs - root cause was contention on the config-store write lock during concurrent rollout-triggered updates (PLAT-487). Mitigation: temporary backoff and queueing for rollout-worker. Patch merged to staging (PR #892).
- Routing (Priya): Canary of new smart-routing policy running in us-west-2 at 10% - latency looks good, but we've seen a small mismatch when fallback to cheaper model variant occurs. Filed follow-up to add stronger model-compatibility checks (JIRA:PLAT-499).
- Auth (Jordan): Reproduced token-renewal race condition with long-running streams - AUTH-301. Short term: increase token refresh jitter and add extra validation on reconnect. PR for client lib changes under review.
- Quotas (Sofia): Noticed incorrect rate-limit resets for users on monthly quotas near timezone boundaries; likely bug in monthly-window computation. Created JIRA QUOTA-210.
- SRE (Ken): Deployed additional control-plane read replicas in eu-central to absorb increased read load; monitoring dashboards updated.

Today / Plan
- Miguel: Roll out staged config-store write-lock patch to production at low traffic window (scheduled 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC). Will monitor write latency and 5xxs; rollback plan in place.
- Priya: Continue canary expansion to 25% in us-west-2, add weighted traffic tests. Also coordinate with model-ops to ensure compatible variants for fallback.
- Jordan: Finish client lib PR for token jitter and add unit/integration tests for stream reconnects. Target merge by EOD.
- Sofia: Implement fix for monthly-window TZ bug; create automated test covering edge-of-month scenarios.
- Ava: Clean up and publish the post-mortem-ish notes for the minor 5xx incidents; prepare stakeholder update for PMs.

Blockers / Risks
- Control plane write contention: While patch exists, we need to validate under production scale. If rollback occurs, must be ready with manual throttling of rollout workers. (Owner: Miguel)
- Routing fallback mismatch: Could lead to correctness regressions if model variants are not strictly compatible. Need explicit compatibility table. (Owner: Priya)
- Auth token race: Some Dedicated customers experiencing reconnects - potential customer impact if not resolved. (Owner: Jordan; escalation to security if needed).
- Quota TZ edge cases: Billing/CS noise if users report incorrect quota resets. (Owner: Sofia)

Decisions / Notes
- Agreed to gate broad rollout of new routing policy until compatibility checks (PLAT-499) are implemented and signed off by Model Ops.
- Control plane patch will be deployed with feature-flag and controlled rolling restart of rollout-workers.
- For auth token issue, temporary mitigation to be backported to the 1.x client SDK to reduce immediate customer impact.

Action Items
- Miguel: Prod deploy config-store patch in low-traffic window and post metrics snapshot to #platform after 30m (due 2026-03-22).
- Priya: Add compatibility checklist and owner for each model variant; update PLAT-499 (due 2026-03-24).
- Jordan: Merge client lib PR and cut a 1.x patch release for SDKs (due 2026-03-22).
- Sofia: Fix monthly-window TZ bug, add tests, link QUOTA-210 to release (due 2026-03-23).
- Ava: Draft stakeholder update and send to PMs + CS with proposed timeline (due 2026-03-22).

Follow-ups / Post-standup items
- Schedule cross-team sync with Model Ops and CS to review routing fallback behavior and potential customer impact scenarios. (Ava + Priya)
- SRE to run load test with config-store patch applied to ensure no hidden latency regressions under 2x traffic. (Ken)

Notes / Misc
- Related tickets and PRs: PLAT-487 (write-lock contention), PLAT-499 (routing compatibility), AUTH-301 (token renew race), QUOTA-210 (monthly TZ bug), GH PR #892.
- Useful links: Confluence control plane roadmap, slack thread in #platform for incident chatter, dashboards in Grafana (control-plane, auth, quotas).

Next standup: 2026-03-22 09:30 PST / 17:30 UTC
